summary_en: FCE Inc. announced a share buyback program authorizing acquisition of up to 1,153,800 shares (approximately 5.2% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock) for a maximum total consideration of 600 million yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from December 1, 2026 through November 30, 2027.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
FCE Inc. resolved on November 19, 2026 to acquire its own shares as authorized under Article 459, Paragraph 1 of the Companies Act. The company will purchase up to 1,153,800 shares, representing approximately 5.2% of shares outstanding (excluding treasury stock), for a maximum aggregate consideration of 600 million yen. Purchases are scheduled to occur between December 1, 2026 and November 30, 2027 through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

The board cited three rationales: improved capital efficiency, enhanced shareholder returns, and operational flexibility to adjust capital allocation in response to changing business conditions. The company believes its current share price does not adequately reflect intrinsic enterprise value and is at discount levels compared to historical price ranges. The company noted that actual acquisition may be partial or suspended depending on market conditions.
